description: Geoportal električne punionice is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Zagreb. Geolocation of electric charging stations in the city of Zagreb. Coverage: Grad Zagreb. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging station geoportal" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Zagreb. Its keywords include geolokacija, električne punionice, promet, geoportal. The listing shows 5 download or service links in KML, GDB, CSV, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
